map.TWSTRS是颈部肌张力障碍(痉挛性斜颈)的标准化评估量表，包含严重程度、致残和: TWSTRS is the standardized assessment scale for cervical dystonia (spasmodic torticollis), with severity, disability and pain subscales and a total of 0-75 points.
map.运动/发声抽动数量、频度、强度、干扰综合评分。: Composite score of motor and vocal tics by number, frequency, intensity and interference.
map.：数量+频度+强度/干扰合计 45 /75：抽动负荷中重度。: Number + frequency + intensity/interference total 45 / 75: moderate to severe tic burden.
map.：合计 18 /75：轻度，以简单抽动为主。: Total 18 / 75: mild, dominated by simple tics.
map.75 分制（含数量、频度、强度与干扰分项限幅），越高越重。: 75-point scale (with capped sub-scores for number, frequency, intensity and interference), higher is worse.
map.强度/干扰按规则限幅合计，避免单维放大。: Intensity and interference are summed with capped rules so that no single dimension can dominate.
